notes.title: Demo V1.0.1
notes.content:
UPDATES ːsteamhappyː

 Bicycle camera improved.
 Dragging packages  in the inventory is easier now.
 Getting in and out of the vehicle is now only with the (F) key.
 Phone key changed (R).
 Package drop-off distances increased.
 Minimap made more understandable.
 Cars in traffic changed.
 First mission made more understandable.


BUGS ːsteamfacepalmː

 Camera is fixed while in the phone or inventory.
 More UI's added to minimap.
 Visual improvements on the map (Roads, Props, etc.).



WHAT'S NEW ːsteamhappyː

 Bigger map, new areas.
 New Type of Delivery Added (Any).
 Motorcycle Added.
 Car Added.
 Third Person/First Person Camera (C) added.
